lockfileRefresh.commitSubject: chore(deps): refresh lockfiles within declared ranges

securityUpdates.remediation: grouped stack-maintenance pull request and its lockfile refresh
securityUpdates.manualRemediation: high and critical alerts, and any advisory the in-range refresh cannot resolve

dispositions.rationale: TypeScript 7 owns every native CLI build while compiler-API consumers use the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package until a stable TypeScript 7 API exists.
dispositions.removeWhen: All compiler-API consumers support the native TypeScript 7 API and the complete declaration, Jest, conformance, browser, mobile, infrastructure, and packed-consumer matrix passes without the alias.

dispositions.rationale: React Native's tested Hermes compiler build is intentionally newer than the npm latest version metadata and must not be downgraded by a latest-version sweep.
dispositions.removeWhen: The React Native toolchain selects a newer compatible Hermes build and the Metro platform contract passes with it.

dispositions.rationale: The relay accepts the supported qrcode peer family; narrowing the floor to one latest patch would break existing valid consumers.
dispositions.removeWhen: A demonstrated incompatible qrcode release requires a semver upper boundary backed by consumer tests.

dispositions.rationale: The relay preserves its established Express 4 and 5 peer compatibility instead of forcing consumers onto the latest major.
dispositions.removeWhen: Tests demonstrate that an admitted Express major cannot satisfy the public adapter contract.

dispositions.rationale: The optional React adapter preserves its documented React 17 through 19 compatibility and does not force an application-wide React upgrade.
dispositions.removeWhen: Tests demonstrate that an admitted React major cannot satisfy the public adapter contract.

dispositions.rationale: Infrastructure compiles and runs against the governed Node 24 LTS line; Node 26 types move only with the runtime migration.
dispositions.removeWhen: The governed infrastructure runtime, images, CI matrix, and support policy migrate together to Node 26.

dispositions.rationale: Babel 8 is a React Native/Metro migration rather than an isolated development dependency patch.
dispositions.removeWhen: The supported React Native and Metro stack declares Babel 8 compatibility and the exact mobile package contract passes.

dispositions.rationale: Babel runtime must remain aligned with the supported React Native/Metro compiler family.
dispositions.removeWhen: Babel core, runtime, React Native, and Metro migrate together with exact-package tests green.

dispositions.rationale: Chalk 6 changes the supported Node/tooling boundary and is reviewed as one consumer-compatible migration across all command-line packages.
dispositions.removeWhen: All CLI consumers support Chalk 6 without changing output or supported runtimes.

dispositions.rationale: The isolated OpenAPI code generator is pinned to its tested compiler API and generated-output reproducibility boundary.
dispositions.removeWhen: The generator and Redocly closure support the new compiler and deterministic codegen remains byte-for-byte clean.

firstParty.publicationHold: Source candidates may remain ahead of npm only while publication is explicitly unauthorized. Registry versions may never be ahead of or diverge from source ownership, and release reconciliation must record every held or published package.

overrideRemovalReview.method: Reconciled the 26 existing selector/value registrations and their source files against main; they remain unchanged with their existing removal evidence. Added only two scoped repairs: remove the unused Chromium-BiDi dependency from Puppeteer 25.11.0 in the CDP-only private browser harness, and enforce patched Zod 4.6.7 within mutation-server-protocol's accepted ^4.1.12 range. Inspected Puppeteer's dynamic BiDi import boundary. Its available upstream upgrade fails the existing provenance downgrade policy. A broad root refresh moves unrelated Babel, Inquirer and Node-type dependencies; the narrow Zod floor preserves those reviewed resolutions. Retain the unchanged Chrome/CDP harness and qualify its full existing browser assertions, Stryker mutation execution, HTTP consumers, frozen graph and unexcluded audit.
overrideRemovalReview.result: The existing 26 substitutions retain their previously recorded compatibility and security rationale. The two additional selectors remove an unused vulnerable development-tool closure and replace vulnerable Zod 4 with an API-compatible patched release. They add no advisory exclusion, threshold change, provenance exception, disabled assertion or public application-wallet API change. Each new repair has a maintainer owner, upstream evidence, a November 6 review date and explicit retirement tests.
overrideRemovalReview.nextReview: Rehearse removal monthly and after changes to the governed upstream dependencies; specifically recheck Puppeteer/Chromium-BiDi provenance and mutation-server-protocol/Zod security floors by 2026-11-06.
